text:
maya: Kicking off EU-south2 cluster bring-up. Goal: mixed arm64 CPU + A100 GPU nodepools, minimal cost for initial perf tests. Who can own network & nodepool validation today?

oz: I can take network. Need to confirm MTU, cross-AZ routing, and whether we can attach ENIs for SR-IOV passthrough for NIC perf.

sanjay: I'll own nodepools and taints/labels. Plan: 2 nodepools "gpu-prod" (p4a / spot) and "cpu-arm" (arm64 reserved), plus a small "infra" pool for addons.

elaine: FYI: billing flagged high egress in last eu region spin-up. Please keep initial test traffic within region and use internal registries.

oncall-bot: checklist: 1) VPC subnets created 2) peering to ci network 3) SG rules for kubelet/health 4) route tables validated. Reply "done" as you finish.

maya: High-level network plan: 3 AZs, /20 per AZ, calico with BGP disabled (we're on cloud routed). MTU set to 1450 for CNI + ENI. Is that OK?

oz: 1450 works. We'll set EFA/ENI MTU to 9000 only on nodes that need RDMA later. For now keep 1450. Also enable ENI trunking for scale.

chris: For node autoscaling: prefer Karpenter for GPU burst and cluster autoscaler for CPU? Karpenter supports GPU now but we have quota constraints. Thoughts?

sanjay: Karpenter for spot GPU scaling makes sense. We'll pin a fallback reserved group so latency-critical jobs don't get preempted. Setup: provisioner with taints: gpu=true:NoSchedule and labels node.kubernetes.io/role=gpu.

maya: Sample kubeadm join cloud-init for arm64 nodes if anyone needs it:

```yaml
#cloud-config
write_files:
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/kubelet.service.d/10-kubeadm.conf
    content: |
      Environment=KUBELET_EXTRA_ARGS="--max-pods=110 --eviction-hard=imagefs.available<2%"
runcmd:
  - kubeadm join 10.0.0.10:6443 --token TOKEN --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash sha256:XXX
```

oz: Add `--feature-gates=RuntimeClass=true` to kubelet if we use nvidia-device-plugin + runtimeClass.

elaine: Reminder: device-plugin and nvidia-driver install should be done via DaemonSet with toleration to `infra` nodes first, validate on single node, then rollout.

maya: Steps to validate after node pools are up:
- kubectl get nodes & verify labels/taints
- run small perf job (tensor perf) pinned to one GPU node
- check kube-proxy, coredns, metrics-server logs
- network pod-to-pod latency: iperf inside same AZ and cross AZ

chris: For cost control: start GPUs as spot, set maxPrice policy, and attach a PersistentVolume snapshot for model cache so re-provisioning is fast. Also enable node-termination handler.

sanjay: Agreed. Also enable `vertical-pod-autoscaler` only on infra/ops namespace to avoid noisy metrics on production.

devops-ci-bot: Pipeline trigger: `infra/cluster/eu-south2/provision` started by @maya. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/ci/20075

maya: Bootstrapping gotchas we hit before:
- kubeadm certs not matching -> ensure controlPlaneEndpoint DNS points to LB and LB health path is /healthz
- MTU mismatch causes image pulls to fail on large layers
- kube-proxy iptables mode vs ipvs performance difference (use ipvs in prod)

oz: Network smoke commands:
- `kubectl exec -it iperf-pod -- iperf3 -c <peer>`
- `curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 http://10.0.0.1:8080/healthz`
- `sudo ethtool -k eth0 | grep tx-checksums`

elaine: I'll run cost projection: for 2 A100s on reserved vs spot for 72h test. Expect ~40% cheaper on spot but with ~5-10% preempt risk. Will post numbers in a bit.

maya: After perf validation, handoff checklist to platform team:
1) Confirm LB + API certs rotated via Vault
2) K8s control plane logs pulled into central ELK
3) RBAC: restrict kube-system write to ops group
4) Document nodepool sizing and autoscaling policies

chris: One more: enable `kubelet --serialize-image-pulls=true` on gpu nodes to avoid too many parallel registry connections.

sanjay: I'll create the kubeadm config file and the kustomize overlay for addons (calico, coredns, metrics-server, nvidia-device-plugin, overprovisioner).

maya: Cool. Can we try a staged rollout: bring up infra + cpu-arm, validate infra, then create one gpu spot node and test drivers, then scale to 2-3 GPUs?

oz: Sounds good. I'll start VPC/subnet creation now and ping when route tables are ready.

elaine: Cost numbers: reserved baseline for 48h test = $X; spot baseline = ~$0.6X. Uploading spreadsheet to #finance later. :money_with_wings:

oncall-bot: mark:eu-south2/bringup status updated -> in-progress.

maya: Thanks team — update the thread with any blockers. If driver install fails, tag @sanjay and @chris.

chris: One potential blocker: quota for GPUs in eu-south2 is low. @maya please open quota increase with cloud provider now (request ID 12345).

maya: Done, request 12345 opened. ETA 24-48h. Will proceed with CPU+infra prep in meantime.

oz: Route table done, IGW and NAT attached, peering to ci network validated. 3 subnets populated.

sanjay: Kubeadm config draft pushed to infra repo: https://git.redwood/infra/eu-south2/kubeadm.yaml. Please review.

maya: End of day summary: infra & cpu nodes in place, network validated, quota request open, GPU provisioning blocked pending quota. Next actions tomorrow: driver dry-run on infra node, Karpenter config, spot policy.

elaine: Added cost controls and tagging policy to repo.

devops-ci-bot: pipeline `infra/cluster/eu-south2/provision` completed step 1/5.

maya: Thanks — thread closed for tonight, will reopen if GPU quota comes through.
